description: Every fund matching filters, with net assets and the source and date of that number. Filters: desk, issuer, max_fee_pct, min_assets_usd, tracks (index), min_yield_pct (12-month), pays (payout frequency), sort. count is the whole set: when fewer rows return, truncated and note say so; first names every fund tied at the top. Fees are percentages. Funds with no data for a filter are set aside and counted, not failed. For "find all X" and "cheapest X".

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk.

issuer.description: Optional: the issuer, matched exactly, case-insensitive, such as Vanguard.

limit.description: Most rows to return. Default 25; at most 200.

max_fee_pct.description: Optional: the highest expense ratio, in percent (0.25 is 0.25%).

min_assets_usd.description: Optional: the smallest net assets, in US dollars.

min_yield_pct.description: 12-month yield of at least this many percent (10 is 10%).

pays.description: Payout frequency, published for income ETFs.

sort.description: assets: largest first; fee: lowest first; yield: highest first.

tracks.description: The index the funds track, such as S&P 500.

name: etf_screen

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
